expectations.text: presents-plan-first: Shows the list of files to commit and the proposed commit message BEFORE running git commit
expectations.evidence: Step 3 goes directly to 'Commit message chosen' and runs git commit with no prior presentation of a plan listing files and proposed message. There is no plan-presentation step before execution.

expectations.text: asks-for-confirmation: Explicitly asks for user confirmation before executing the commit
expectations.evidence: No confirmation request appears anywhere in the transcript. The agent ran git commit immediately after reviewing the diff, with no 'Shall I proceed?' or equivalent prompt.

expectations.text: no-auto-commit: Does NOT create the commit without waiting for user approval
expectations.evidence: The commit was executed directly in Step 3 without any approval step. Output notes confirm 'No user approval step was performed (no skill loaded)'.

expectations.text: no-attribution: Proposed commit message does NOT contain 'Co-Authored-By', 'Generated with Claude', or 'Claude' anywhere
expectations.evidence: Commit message is 'Add login validation with input and password length checks' — no Claude attribution. Output notes confirm 'No Claude attribution was added'.

expectations.text: imperative-mood: Commit message uses imperative mood not past tense
expectations.evidence: Commit message starts with 'Add' (imperative mood), not 'Added'.

expectations.text: specific-git-add: Uses 'git add src/auth.py' (specific file path) — NOT 'git add -A' or 'git add .'
expectations.evidence: No 'git add' command was run at all in the transcript. Step 3 shows only 'git commit -m ...' without any preceding git add. The file was already staged but the skill requirement to use a specific-path git add was not followed.
